## File: facebookresearch_cutler/videocutler/mask2former/modeling/backbone/swin.py

Prompts

```
['build a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depths, num_heads, window_size, and embed_dim for vision tasks', 'create a D2SwinTransformer registered in Detectron2 BACKBONE_REGISTRY using config MODEL.SWIN settings', 'test the WindowAttention module with relative position bias and optional attention mask input', 'review the SwinTransformerBlock forward pass including cyclic shift, window partitioning, and W-MSA/SW-MSA', 'refactor the PatchMerging layer to reduce spatial resolution by half while doubling channel dimension']
```
